limits: Nominal Coulomb capacity mu*(Nleft+Nright) is a model-assumption upper bound, not measured vertical friction or calibrated hardware load capacity.
Balanced per-finger target is the existing weight-based safety=2 design assumption; total capacity can differ from a weak-finger condition.
Scalar stiffness times joint compression is a configuration heuristic; measured tensor forces and changing contacts remain primary evidence.
Contact confirmed means continuous force above0.03N, not demonstrated load-bearing force or task success.
